title: Classic to Wrath
editionLabel: World of Warcraft · Classic, The Burning Crusade, and Wrath of the Lich King
summary: Choose a story from the map, or play the completed stories in chronological order across Azeroth, Outland, and Northrend.
opening: Azeroth's northern continents, the broken world of Outland, and the frozen reaches of Northrend frame a new kind of journey: each story stands on its own, while the whole tour follows the great campaigns in turn.
mapAlt: An original interpretive world atlas: Kalimdor to the west, the Eastern Kingdoms to the east, Northrend in the north, and Outland as a separate shattered landmass at the lower right, with varied marsh, forest, volcanic, and crystal terrain.
mapInterpretationNote: Original AI-generated overview art for tour navigation, not an official World of Warcraft map or a surveyed geographic reconstruction. Story markers use illustration layout positions only; they are not atlas coordinates or exact zone locations. Outland is a separate worldspace and is shown detached from Azeroth; no travel route is implied. Intended visual reference: the Wrath of the Lich King world presentation, before Cataclysm changed Azeroth.
chronologyNote: Play-all order is an editorial expansion-era sequence: original Classic (Onyxia, Scepter, Dungeon Set 2, the Fallen Hero, then Tirion and Taelan), followed by The Burning Crusade (Karazhan, Akama and the Black Temple, then the Cipher of Damnation preview), and Wrath of the Lich King (Wrathgate preview). The TBC placements organize this map and do not claim canonical relative dates or causal links. The Scepter ancient prologue is a flashback; Dungeon Set 2 companion fates are alternatives; the Fallen Hero faction openings are mutually exclusive; Tirion and Taelan ends at its Classic quest resolution; and Akama raid gates are not one continuous historical campaign. The Hyjal passage is a labeled historical instance, not a route from Outland.

reviewNote: Playable research stories: The Dragon in Stormwind, Scepter of the Shifting Sands, Dungeon Set 2: The Veiled Blade and Lord Valthalak, The Fallen Hero and Rakhlikh, Tirion and Taelan: Of Love and Family, Karazhan: The Masters Key and Nightbane, and Akama and the Black Temple. The Outland Cipher of Damnation and Northrend Wrathgate remain research previews outside Play All. Original-client quests and builds, faction variants, relative Classic ordering, map art, and matching in-game area/model resemblance remain open for human review; story markers are not exact locations or travel routes.
